title: Tamsin and the Interior
author: Sebastian Ravensworth
blurb: Odile Coldharbour, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
